## Earnie 2.5.0-alpha.4

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5** line (follow-up to `2.5.0-alpha.3`). Focus: Chart-1 SoC vs ESS underlay, Manuelle Geräte QH starts, EV remaining energy, SE QH energy, runtime filenames.

### Highlights

- **Chart-1 SoC** — current-hour ramp no longer wipes later MILP quarters; Jetzt-Anker uses MILP polyline when later QH exist
- **Manuelle Geräte** — start slots keep QH minutes; current slot plus `:00`/`:30` across the wall-clock horizon (not one check per hour)
- **EV session remaining** — plugged-in Ist-SOC remaining is not reduced again by booked kWh (dump `20260813_075350`, stop at ~58% with leftover 0.5 kWh)
- **SE non-optimized costs** — QH slots use energy `kW * dt_h` (was ~4× too high)
- **Filenames** — `cons_data.csv` / `backtesting.csv` (legacy `*_hourly*` still loads)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.0-alpha.4` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.4.0**).
